in_sanskrit.name: मेथुर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is vast and inimical, or the one who has a dual nature, or the one who has two natures.

in_tamil.name: ஹெமினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of time and space, or the one who has the power to control both time and space.

in_telugu.name: హెమిని
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is inimical or harmful.

in_marathi.name: Gemini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who has two bodies
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gemini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has two bodies or two minds. This name is derived from the constellation of the same name in the zodiac, which represents the twins Castor and Pollux. In Hindu astrology, this sign is ruled by Mercury and represents adaptability, versatility, and the ability to learn and communicate effectively.

in_bengali.name: Gemini
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ One who has two bodies
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gemini একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has two bodies or two minds. This name is derived from the constellation of the same name in the zodiac, which represents the twins Castor and Pollux. In Hindu astrology, this sign is ruled by Mercury and represents adaptability, versatility, and the ability to learn and communicate effectively.
